request.subject: Need a replacement hydraulic seal kit
request.body: Our press line is down — can you confirm stock on SP-100 and lead time?

reply.subject: Re: Need a replacement hydraulic seal kit
reply.body: SP-100 is in stock (40 units) — happy to ship today. Shall I prepare a quote?

request.subject: Bearing set pricing for a repeat order
request.body: We need 10x SP-200 again at the usual terms — can you send a quote?

reply.subject: Re: Bearing set pricing for a repeat order
reply.body: Quote attached for 10x SP-200 at list price, NET14 as usual.

request.subject: Drive belt stock check

reply.body: Yes — 250 pcs in stock. I can reserve 25 for you, let me know and I'll draft the order.
